summary: Ten-planet metadata for app display, speed weighting, and modern/traditional separation.
body: The app may track modern planets, but traditional chart-ruler and dignity language should stay anchored to the traditional seven unless a modern lens is explicitly selected.
definition: Planet metadata includes labels, classification, sect relevance, retrograde capability, and approximate daily speed.
appUsage: Use modern flagging to keep outer planets contextual rather than primary in traditional logic.
Use speed hints to help rank daily transit weight.
Do not name outer planets as traditional rulers in user-facing ruler text.
note: Imported from the project policy bundle; source file was not copied into the repo.
